credits.title: I Am Going to Miss You
credits.overview: Amanda and Caio are a trans couple who share seven years of love and dreams. However, when they decide to live together, the differences between them begin to take their toll.

credits.title: Sister
credits.overview: Ian has grown into Iara, proudly embracing her identity. Rejecting her family's legacy of violence, Iara guides her sister through memories and letters, where childhood wounds resurface at an ancient waterfall whose waters once baptized their parents in the evangelical faith.

credits.title: Sandra
credits.overview: Sandra is an insurance broker staying at a hotel with her team for a training session led by a famous coach. When a mysterious phone call wakes her in her room, she realizes she is being watched by a foreign guest.

credits.title: Picumã
credits.overview: Picumã is an action film that follows the journey of three travestis. One of them, Cleo, mysteriously disappears. Lua and Shaiene set out on a search to uncover their friend’s whereabouts. Time is running out, and their success will determine whether Cleo lives or dies.

credits.title: The Lurcher's Stall
credits.overview: Retired and facing financial problems, Sara opens a stall to make some cash and get rid of all the belongings she has accumulated throughout her life, making up stories so she doesn't have to take anything back to her lonely home.

credits.title: I Seek Your Help to Bury a Man
credits.overview: Empire of Brazil, 1870. A queer indigenous body slowly dies on the cross while a transgender gypsy woman is banned by her people. A half-breed soldier stands in the middle of the way. A child and an old woman cross their stories like destined lines on the palm of a hand.

credits.title: One Hit Wonders
credits.overview: 12-year-old Barbara dreams of meeting her idol Venus, a one hit wonder from the 80s who has gone missing. When a mysterious person moves to her neighborhood, Barbara sees an opportunity to finally solve the mystery of Venus.

credits.title: Ménage
credits.overview: Three corrupt emeritus from the same small political party involved in a plot of sex, corruption and betrayal are the main characters of an agile, dreamlike plot that refers to the best achievements of Brazilian marginal cinema.

credits.title: Dead Model, Live Model
credits.overview: Manuela, a trans woman, an artist, who, when attending a live model workshop, awakens to her own beauty and power, even though she has to face everyday difficulties, which require courage and determination.

credits.title: Don't Call Me That
credits.overview: Daniela is about to have her long-awaited gender reassignment surgery, and she can't think about anything else. Roberto, her lover, tries to dissuade her from doing it, revealing an unsettling relationship that awakes past traumas.
